The '''1930-31 Serie A''' was the thirty-first edition of the [[Italian Football Championship]] and the second since [[1929–30 Serie A|1929]] re-[[brand]]ing to create [[Serie A]]. It was the eighth season from which the Italian Football Champions adorned their team jerseys in the subsequent season with a [[Scudetto]]. [[Juventus]] won for the first of five successive wins, and for the third time in their [[history]]. This was their second scudetto since the scudetto started being awarded in [[1923–24 Prima Divisione|1924]] and their first win contested as Serie A.

[[Image:Serie A (football) 1930-31.png|thumb|325px|right|Serie A 1930-31 teams distribution]]

==Teams==
[[A.S. Casale Calcio|Casale]] and [[Legnano Calcio|Legnano]] had been promoted from [[Serie B]].
